scripts.netlify-build: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@7 --activate && pnpm install && pnpm build && echo '--- debug: list .netlify ---' && ls -la .netlify || true && echo '--- debug: list .netlify/output ---' && ls -la .netlify/output || true && echo '--- debug: pwd & root list ---' && pwd && ls -la
scripts.netlify-export: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@7 --activate && pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm run export && echo '--- debug: list out ---' && ls -la out || true && pwd && ls -la
